## berth

berth: one Claude Code container per organization

### Synopsis

berth: one Claude Code container per organization.

Every command lives in one group: `berth <group> --help` lists its commands, and every command has
its own --help. The everyday ones also work on their own: berth up acme is berth org up acme.
Leave the org out to use the default one (berth org use).

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/

```
berth [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for berth
      --home string     state root (default: $BERTH_HOME, then home: in config.yaml, then ~/.local/share/berth)
      --output string   output format for commands that return data: text or json (docs/json.md) (default "text")
      --read-only       refuse any command that would change state
      --version         print the berth version
```
